data.title: 鸢一折纸 · 练习后的完整午餐
data.description: 练习结束，折纸穿浅青运动外套坐在体育馆外长椅上，把能量棒放回包里，打开认真准备的饭盒。她逐一摆好筷子和水瓶，检查齐全后才夹起第一口，平静表情中有一点不易察觉的满意。
data.action: 收起能量棒，摆齐餐具后认真吃第一口便当。
data.promptProse: Origami returns an energy bar to her sports bag, aligns the chopsticks and water bottle beside her opened lunch, then selects the first bite. Her pale-teal track jacket and charcoal trousers belong to the finished practice session. The seated medium view includes the bench outside the gym, its entrance behind her silver bob. Bright open shade reveals her satisfied expression and meal, with gentle contact shadows beneath the containers.
